title: feat(gen): add ?community query parameter to model discovery endpoints
author: fisventurous
pr_body_excerpt:
adds optional `?community` query parameter to model discovery endpoints so client apps and bots can filter out community models when they only want core official models

changes
\- new `filterEntriesByCommunityParam` helper in `proxy.ts`, applied inside `modelsListHandler` and the inline `/v1/models` handler
\- `?community=false` (or `0`) excludes community models, `?community=true` (or `1`) returns only community models
\- omitting the parameter returns all models (fully backward compatible)
\- updated OpenAPI descriptions on `/v1/models`, `/models`, `/text/models`, `/image/models` to document the parameter
\- added query parameter docs section in `models.md`
\- integration test covering `/models`, `/text/models`, `/v1/models`, `/image/models` with `true`, `false`, `1`, `0`, and omitted variants

gist.headline: The model garden has gates
gist.blurb: Model discovery now comes with a tidy little filter. Ask for the official beds, the community greenhouse, or wander through the whole garden as before.
gist.summary: Added an optional `?community` filter to `/v1/models`, `/models`, `/text/models`, and `/image/models`, where `true` or `1` returns only community models, `false` or `0` returns official models, and omission preserves the full list.
gist.impact: Apps and bots can now discover the exact model catalog they need without client-side filtering, while existing model-list requests continue returning every model unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy model garden split into two clearly labeled flower beds: official core models in one and community-grown models in the other, with a small query-filter valve choosing which blooms appear. Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, tends the labels beside a retro terminal, making the filtering feel precise but friendly.
